mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant for two consecutive months above 5.25%, market expectations for future rate cuts increase, lowering real discount rates and boosting equity present-value pricing, which drives a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: FOMC holds or signals hold after a restrictive stance
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day average preceding the trigger (t-test p > 0.05) during qualifying FEDFUNDS windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in CPIAUCSL by at least 0.4% followed by a stabilization is interpreted as a deflationary surprise that reduces real borrowing costs and accelerates equity discounting, producing a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL drops ≥ 0.4% in a month then remains flat for the next two months
failure_condition: During such CPIAUCSL events, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or flat (mean ratio ≤ 1.0 over 10 events).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS of at least 10,000 jobs above the prior month's level, sustained for two consecutive months, indicates strengthening labor market conditions that reduce risk premia and support equity valuations, driving a positive 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases ≥ 10,000 month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: During qualifying PAYEMS spikes, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or fail to exceed the prior month's average by 1.5 standard deviations.

mechanism_narrative: When both HOUST and INDPRO show simultaneous monthly increases exceeding 5% and 2%, respectively, it signals accelerating business and consumer demand, which elevates earnings expectations and supports higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST ↑ > 5% AND INDPRO ↑ > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: During such dual-proxy upswings, SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in RSAFS of at least 15% accompanied by a 3-month rising trend in GDPC1 suggests weakening inventory absorption and rising absorption capacity, which can depress near-term supply-cost pressures and drive a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rising trend (3 months) AND RSAFS ↓ ≥ 15% in the current month
failure_condition: During qualifying RSAFS/GDPC1 events, SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly above the 30-day average (mean ratio ≤ 1.02, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in UNRATE above 4.5% for three consecutive months is interpreted as wage growth accelerating beyond expectations, which raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: During such UNRATE spikes, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the 30-day average preceding the trigger (mean ratio ≥ 1.02, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25% in a single month while CPIAUCSL remains flat, it signals a shift toward tighter policy expectations that elevates real risk-free rates and dampens equity valuations, resulting in a negative S&P 500 60-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS ↑ ≥ 0.25% AND CPIAUCSL unchanged for the month
failure_condition: During such policy tightening events, SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly worse than during prior FEDFUNDS rises (mean ratio ≥ 1.01, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive two-month decline in INDPRO below 90 (index=100 baseline) coupled with a stabilization in HOUST suggests softening supply constraints and improving absorption, which can lower input costs and support equity valuations, producing a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return in non-recessionary regimes.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 90 for two consecutive months AND HOUST stable
failure_condition: During such INDPRO/HOUST patterns in non-recessionary regimes, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline (mean ratio ≤ 1.02, p > 0.05).
